description: Mempool health: backlog growth, batch production and certification, and transaction finalization latency.

panels.description: Sustained positive growth means transactions arrive faster than they finalize or expire.
panels.title: Net backlog growth /s

panels.description: Transactions dropped by the mempool after RPC acceptance without executing (supra_mempool_transactions_rejected_total), broken down by reason. Complements the RPC node's pre-mempool supra_transactions_rejected_total: together they cover a transaction's whole acceptance path. "expired" is TTL; "stale_sequence_number" means the chain advanced past the transaction since it was accepted.
panels.title: Mempool rejections /s by reason

panels.description: Certification rate should track creation rate; divergence means availability certificates are not forming.
panels.title: Batches created vs certified /s

panels.description: Batch creation to availability-certificate assembly for locally-proposed batches.
panels.title: Batch certification latency
Latest batch certification latency by instance

panels.description: End-to-end: transaction enters the backlog until it is finalized. The closest validator-side proxy for user-perceived latency.
panels.title: Transaction finalization latency
Latest transaction finalization latency by instance

panels.description: Batch availability sync; a nonzero rate means batches referenced by proposals were missing locally.
panels.title: Outgoing batch sync requests /s

panels.description: Batch sync requests received from peers, i.e. batches that peers are missing and expect this node to have. Counted before authorization and rate-limiting, so this is offered rather than served load.
panels.title: Incoming batch sync requests /s

panels.description: Fraction of locally-created batches that obtained an availability certificate (rate of batch certificates / rate of batches created).
panels.title: Batch certification yield

panels.description: Transactions awaiting signature verification in the local BatchProposer (supra.mempool.verification_queue_depth.current). Bounded by num_cpus by construction — a queue pinned at the bound means verification is the throughput bottleneck.
panels.title: Verification queue depth by instance
